Package testing

Class ContributorManualTestbed

java.lang.Object
testing.ContributorManualTestbed
public class ContributorManualTestbed extends Object

Title: ContributorManualTestbed Class.

Description: Interactive console-based manual testbed modeled after the Foundations PasswordEvaluationTestbed. Allows a developer or grader to manually exercise Contributor CRUD operations, test custom positive and negative boundary inputs, switch active user roles to verify ownership authorization guards, exercise TP3 forward-compatible hooks, or invoke the full 28-test semi-automated suite (ContributorTestingAutomation).

Manual Test Procedures Documented in Javadocs:

  • executeManualCreateTest(LessonLearnedList, User, String, String, String) — Manual verification of TP2-REQ-01, TP2-REQ-02, TP2-REQ-03, and TP2-REQ-04
  • executeManualReadAndSearchTest(LessonLearnedList, String, String) — Manual verification of TP2-REQ-05, TP2-REQ-06, and TP2-REQ-07
  • executeManualUpdateTest(LessonLearnedList, User, int, String, String, String) — Manual verification of TP2-REQ-08 and TP2-REQ-09
  • executeManualDeleteTest(LessonLearnedList, User, int) — Manual verification of TP2-REQ-10 and TP2-REQ-11
  • executeManualTP3GovernanceTest(LessonLearnedList, int, boolean, String, boolean) — Manual verification of TP2-REQ-12

    • executeManualCreateTest

      public static boolean executeManualCreateTest(LessonLearnedList list, User activeUser, String title, String description, String category)

      Method: executeManualCreateTest(LessonLearnedList list, User activeUser, String title, String description, String category)

      Requirements Tested: TP2-REQ-01, TP2-REQ-02, TP2-REQ-03, and TP2-REQ-04 (Manual Create and Input Validation evaluation).

      How the Code Implements Satisfaction of the Requirements: Validates the user-entered title, description, author, and category via ContributorValidator.validateLessonFields(String, String, String, String) before instantiating a LessonLearned and adding it to LessonLearnedList.addLesson(LessonLearned).

      How to Interpret the Output to Know if the Test Passed: For a positive manual input, the console prints [MANUAL CREATE PASS] along with the assigned ID and updated collection count. For a negative manual input (such as a blank title or short description), the test passes if the console prints [MANUAL CREATE REJECTED] with the specific field validation error and leaves the collection count unchanged.

      Parameters:
      list - target LessonLearnedList collection
      activeUser - currently logged-in User authoring the lesson
      title - entered title string
      description - entered description string
      category - entered category string
      Returns:
      true if the lesson was valid and created, false if rejected by validation

    • executeManualReadAndSearchTest

      public static int executeManualReadAndSearchTest(LessonLearnedList list, String keyword, String category)

      Method: executeManualReadAndSearchTest(LessonLearnedList list, String keyword, String category)

      Requirements Tested: TP2-REQ-05, TP2-REQ-06, and TP2-REQ-07 (Manual Read All, Keyword Search, and Category Filter evaluation).

      How the Code Implements Satisfaction of the Requirements: Validates the search query length via ContributorValidator.validateSearchKeyword(String), executes LessonLearnedList.searchByKeyword(String) or LessonLearnedList.filterByCategory(String), and prints all matching records in currentSubset.

      How to Interpret the Output to Know if the Test Passed: The console prints [MANUAL READ/SEARCH RESULT] with the subset size and lists each matching record, or prints [MANUAL SEARCH REJECTED] if the keyword exceeds 64 characters.

      Parameters:
      list - target LessonLearnedList collection
      keyword - search keyword (or blank)
      category - category filter (or "All")
      Returns:
      number of matching records in the resulting subset, or -1 if validation failed

    • executeManualUpdateTest

      public static boolean executeManualUpdateTest(LessonLearnedList list, User activeUser, int id, String newTitle, String newDescription, String newCategory)

      Method: executeManualUpdateTest(LessonLearnedList list, User activeUser, int id, String newTitle, String newDescription, String newCategory)

      Requirements Tested: TP2-REQ-08 and TP2-REQ-09 (Manual Update and Ownership Authorization evaluation).

      How the Code Implements Satisfaction of the Requirements: Locates the target record via LessonLearnedList.findById(int), checks ownership permission via ContributorValidator.verifyModifyPermission(LessonLearned, User), validates the updated fields via ContributorValidator.validateLessonFields(String, String, String, String), and applies the update via LessonLearnedList.updateLesson(int, String, String, String).

      How to Interpret the Output to Know if the Test Passed: Outputs [MANUAL UPDATE PASS] when an authorized user supplies valid fields for an existing ID, or [MANUAL UPDATE REJECTED] with the specific not-found, authorization, or field boundary error message.

      Parameters:
      list - target LessonLearnedList collection
      activeUser - currently logged-in User attempting the update
      id - primary key ID of the lesson to update
      newTitle - updated title string
      newDescription - updated description string
      newCategory - updated category string
      Returns:
      true if the update succeeded, false if rejected

    • executeManualDeleteTest

      public static boolean executeManualDeleteTest(LessonLearnedList list, User activeUser, int id)

      Method: executeManualDeleteTest(LessonLearnedList list, User activeUser, int id)

      Requirements Tested: TP2-REQ-10 and TP2-REQ-11 (Manual Delete and Ownership Authorization evaluation).

      How the Code Implements Satisfaction of the Requirements: Checks whether ID exists via LessonLearnedList.findById(int), verifies ownership or Admin privileges via ContributorValidator.verifyModifyPermission(LessonLearned, User), and removes the record via LessonLearnedList.deleteLesson(int).

      How to Interpret the Output to Know if the Test Passed: Prints [MANUAL DELETE PASS] when an authorized user deletes an existing lesson, or [MANUAL DELETE REJECTED] when the ID is invalid/missing or the user lacks permission.

      Parameters:
      list - target LessonLearnedList collection
      activeUser - currently logged-in User attempting deletion
      id - primary key ID of the lesson to delete
      Returns:
      true if deleted, false if rejected

    • executeManualTP3GovernanceTest

      public static boolean executeManualTP3GovernanceTest(LessonLearnedList list, int id, boolean flagged, String note, boolean verified)

      Method: executeManualTP3GovernanceTest(LessonLearnedList list, int id, boolean flagged, String note, boolean verified)

      Requirements Tested: TP2-REQ-12 (Manual evaluation of TP3 forward-compatible moderation flag, peer endorsement counter, and staff verification hooks).

      How the Code Implements Satisfaction of the Requirements: Invokes LessonLearnedList.setModerationFlag(int, boolean, String), LessonLearnedList.incrementEndorsement(int), and LessonLearnedList.setTechnicalVerification(int, boolean) on the specified lesson ID.

      How to Interpret the Output to Know if the Test Passed: Prints [MANUAL TP3 HOOKS PASS] with the updated flag, moderation note, endorsement count, and verification status when the ID exists, or [MANUAL TP3 HOOKS REJECTED] when the ID does not exist.

      Parameters:
      list - target LessonLearnedList collection
      id - primary key ID of the lesson
      flagged - moderation flag state to set
      note - administrative moderation explanation note
      verified - staff verification state to set
      Returns:
      true if all hooks succeeded, false if lesson ID was not found
